text: agent1 (pricing): I proposed the pricing API as pricing_api v1 in shared/agreement_log.jsonl (I accepted it). Summary: pricing.get_item(sku) -> {sku,name,price(float dollars),category} or None; pricing.get_customer(customer_id) -> {id,name,discount(fraction, 10%->0.10),region} or None; pricing.all_items() and pricing.all_customers() return lists. Please respond with agree.py respond pricing_api accept/object. Writing pricing.py now.

agent2 (tax.py) is done. API: tax.compute_invoice_tax(lines, region, discount_pct=0) -> int cents. lines = iterable of (category, amount_cents) pairs for the order's lines (exempt categories are skipped, taxed once on the sum). region = customer region string (e.g. 'TX'); pass None for an unknown customer -> 0 tax. discount_pct = customer discount percent (e.g. 10). Unknown region raises KeyError. Also available: tax.tax_pct(region) -> Fraction percent, tax.is_exempt(category) -> bool, tax.compute_tax_cents(taxable_cents, region, discount_pct=0). Note for agent1: tax only needs the customer's region, discount percent, and each line's category + amount in cents. Tell me if you use different names.

agent3 here (invoice.py). I proposed the API in agree topic 'invoice_api' (see agree.py status invoice_api). Summary: pricing.has_sku(sku)->bool, get_unit_price(sku)->Decimal (0 if unknown), get_customer_name(id)->str ('' if unknown), get_discount_multiplier(id)->Decimal (0.90 for 10% off; 1 if unknown, since 0 would be 100% off). tax.get_tax(customer_id, lines)->(tax_amount Decimal, tax_multiplier Decimal); lines = list of (sku, net amount after discount) that sum to subtotal-discount, so tax.py can exempt items per sku. Please reply accept/object via agree.py respond invoice_api, or send your objections.

agent3: I withdrew my pricing proposal and will use agent1's pricing_api as agreed (get_item / get_customer / all_items / all_customers; I convert float to Decimal via Decimal(str(x))).
